title: Singleton influence accuracy
statement: Let $t>0$ be a rational influence bound and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter. The singleton influence accuracy is the smaller of one half and one quarter of the learning consequences threshold for $t$ and $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the learning consequences threshold.
